links.title: UK campus students | Heriot-Watt University
links.description: You may be aware of the recent UK Government announcement on the Immigration White Paper regarding international students and other immigration routes which will involve changes to the UK’s visa regulations. Please be aware that these changes will not take immediate effect and may take months to enact into law and some new policies might not even be in place until next year. Heriot-Watt welcomes the confirmation that the Graduate Post-Study Work route will remain open and competitive although with a reduced duration. That means that international students can remain in the UK and work for up to 18 months after completing their studies, gaining experience, and helping to address critical skills shortages. Dependants on all routes including the student route will eventually be required to pass a basic English language assessment if they are applying for a Dependant visa, we do not know when this will come into place. The route to short term settlement will increase from 5 years to 10 years even if someone is on the skilled migrant visa. Please be assured that international students continue to be warmly received at Heriot-Watt. Your contribution is hugely valued and your decision to study here is extremely important to us. We will support you at every stage of your student journey. Our University is proud of its status worldwide as a culturally diverse, warm and welcoming institution. Our global footprint includes campuses in Dubai, Malaysia, Edinburgh, the Scottish Borders and Orkney. Our doors remain firmly open to international students. If you have any questions about studying with us, please get in touch with us at studywithus@hw.ac.uk . We look forward to welcoming you soon.
headings: Contact the Visa, Advice and Compliance team
